## 1. Batch Processing Flowchart

Shows how 500 accumulated messages flow through monitoring, filtering, triage, and response phases.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["📬 Daily Message Collection<br/>500 total messages"] --> B["🪝 HOOK: Spam Filter<br/>Remove spam & duplicates"]
    B --> B1["✅ 225 valid messages<br/>5 spam filtered"]

    B1 --> C["📊 PHASE 1: Monitoring<br/>Multi-channel collection"]
    C --> C1["🐦 Twitter<br/>80 messages"]
    C --> C2["💼 LinkedIn<br/>20 messages"]
    C --> C3["📷 Instagram<br/>50 messages"]
    C --> C4["📧 Email<br/>45 messages"]
    C --> C5["💬 Chat<br/>30 messages"]

    C1 & C2 & C3 & C4 & C5 --> D["🪝 HOOK: Sentiment Check<br/>Analyze tone & urgency"]

    D --> E["🏷️ PHASE 2: Triage<br/>Categorize & Prioritize"]
    E --> E1["Support: 100"]
    E --> E2["Sales: 40"]
    E --> E3["Feedback: 30"]
    E --> E4["Complaint: 20"]
    E --> E5["Compliment: 30"]
    E --> E6["Spam: 5"]

    E1 & E2 & E3 & E4 & E5 & E6 --> F["⚡ PHASE 3: Response Logic<br/>Auto vs Escalate"]

    F --> G{Complexity < 7?<br/>Mode = Respond?}

    G -->|Yes: 70%<br/>140 messages| H["🤖 AUTO-RESPOND Branch"]
    G -->|No: 30%<br/>60 messages| I["👤 ESCALATE Branch"]

    H --> H1["📚 FAQ Responder<br/>60 responses"]
    H --> H2["🔧 Support Responder<br/>50 responses"]
    H --> H3["💰 Sales Responder<br/>30 responses"]

    H1 & H2 & H3 --> J["🪝 HOOK: Response Quality<br/>Grammar, tone, links verified"]

    I --> I1["📋 Create Support Ticket"]
    I --> I2["💡 Generate Summary"]
    I --> I3["📤 Notify Human"]
    I1 & I2 & I3 --> J

    J --> K["✅ Response Sent"]
    K --> L["📊 PHASE 4: Analytics<br/>Track metrics & trends"]
    L --> M["📈 Daily Report Generated"]
```

## 2. Batch Wave Execution Timeline (Gantt)

Shows how 500 messages are processed in 25 waves of 20 messages each, with parallel processing.

```mermaid
gantt

    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm

    section Monitoring

    Email Monitor      :active, monitor2, 2025-11-17 08:00, 5m
    Chat Monitor       :active, monitor3, 2025-11-17 08:00, 5m
    Merge & Dedup      :crit, merge, 2025-11-17 08:05, 2m

    section Filtering
    Spam Filter (Hook) :crit, spamfilter, 2025-11-17 08:07, 2m
    Sentiment Check    :crit, sentiment, 2025-11-17 08:09, 3m

    section Triage (Parallel)
    Categorizer Agent  :active, cat, 2025-11-17 08:12, 5m
    Prioritizer Agent  :active, pri, 2025-11-17 08:12, 5m

    section Wave Processing
    Waves 1-5 (Auto)   :active, wave1, 2025-11-17 08:17, 10m
    Waves 1-5 (Escalate) :active, wave1e, 2025-11-17 08:17, 10m
    Waves 6-15 (Auto)  :active, wave2, 2025-11-17 08:27, 20m
    Waves 6-15 (Escalate) :active, wave2e, 2025-11-17 08:27, 20m
    Waves 16-25 (Auto) :active, wave3, 2025-11-17 08:47, 20m
    Waves 16-25 (Escalate) :active, wave3e, 2025-11-17 08:47, 20m

    section QA & Output
    Response Quality   :crit, qa, 2025-11-17 09:07, 5m
    Analytics Report   :crit, report, 2025-11-17 09:12, 3m
    Human Review Start :milestone, humstart, 2025-11-17 09:15, 0m

    section Human Processing
    Human Escalation Review :human, human1, 2025-11-17 09:15, 60m
```

**Timeline Summary**:
- 08:00-08:07: Parallel monitoring (5 min) + dedup (2 min)
- 08:07-08:12: Filtering hooks (5 min)
- 08:12-08:17: Triage parallel (5 min)
- 08:17-09:07: Wave processing (50 min for 25 waves)
- 09:07-09:12: Quality check & reporting (5 min)
- **Total automated**: ~62 minutes
- **Human escalations**: ~60 minutes (parallel with automation)
- **Total time**: ~2 hours

## 3. Sequence Diagram: Batch Coordinator & Agent Waves

Shows the orchestration pattern: coordinator sends waves to parallel agent pools.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant BC as Batch Coordinator
    participant MA as Monitor Agents
    participant TG as Triage Agents
    participant AR as Auto-Response Agents
    participant ES as Escalation Agent
    participant HM as Human Manager

    BC->>MA: Start: Monitor all channels (parallel)
    par
        MA->>MA: Social Monitor (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook)
        MA->>MA: Email Monitor (support@, hello@, contact@)
        MA->>MA: Chat Monitor (Discord, Slack, Intercom)
    end
    MA-->>BC: 500 messages collected

    BC->>BC: Filter spam, deduplicate
    Note over BC: 225 valid messages, 5 spam filtered

    BC->>TG: Start: Categorize & Prioritize (parallel)
    par
        TG->>TG: Categorizer (6 categories)
        TG->>TG: Prioritizer (P0-P3 + complexity)
    end
    TG-->>BC: Triaged messages with scores

    BC->>BC: Branch decision: Complexity < 7?

    par Auto-Respond Path
        BC->>AR: Wave 1-25: Route easy messages (140 total)
        par
            AR->>AR: FAQ Responder (60 messages)
            AR->>AR: Support Responder (50 messages)
            AR->>AR: Sales Responder (30 messages)
        end
        AR-->>BC: 140 responses generated
    and Escalation Path
        BC->>ES: Route complex messages (60 total)
        ES->>ES: Create tickets in support system
        ES->>ES: Generate summaries & suggestions
        ES->>HM: Notify via Slack (priority-based)
        HM-->>ES: Human takes ownership
        ES-->>BC: 60 escalations created
    end

    BC->>BC: Quality check (grammar, tone, links)
    BC->>HM: Send responses to channels (auto)
    BC->>HM: Create escalation queue (for human review)

    Note over BC,HM: Total time: 2 hours (vs 8.3 manual)
    BC-->>HM: Daily analytics report
```

**Key orchestration points**:
1. **Batch Coordinator** manages all phases sequentially
2. **Monitoring Agents** run in parallel (5 channels)
3. **Triage Agents** run in parallel (categorize + prioritize)
4. **Response branches** split: auto (parallel pool) vs escalate (sequential)
5. **Human Manager** reviews escalations asynchronously

## 4. Message State Machine

Shows the lifecycle of a single message through the workflow.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Collected: Message arrives<br/>from channel

    Collected --> SpamCheck: Stored in buffer

    SpamCheck --> Filtered: Spam detected<br/>(keywords, links, blocklist)
    SpamCheck --> Categorized: Legitimate

    Filtered --> Archived: Skip processing<br/>(add to spam logs)

    Categorized --> Triaged: Assign category<br/>(Support/Sales/Feedback/etc)

    Triaged --> Prioritized: Assign priority<br/>(P0-P3) & complexity

    Prioritized --> DecisionPoint: Calculate<br/>escalation score

    DecisionPoint --> AutoRespond: Complexity < 7?<br/>✅ YES (70%)
    DecisionPoint --> Escalate: Complexity >= 7?<br/>❌ NO (30%)

    AutoRespond --> Responding: Select responder<br/>(FAQ/Support/Sales)

    Responding --> QualityCheck: Generate response<br/>text

    Escalate --> EscalationTicket: Create support<br/>ticket

    EscalationTicket --> HumanReview: Notify human<br/>via Slack

    HumanReview --> QualityCheck: Human drafts<br/>response

    QualityCheck --> QAPassed: Grammar OK?<br/>Tone OK?<br/>Links work?

    QAPassed --> Sent: ✅ All checks<br/>passed

    QAPassed --> Regenerate: ❌ Failed QA<br/>try again

    Regenerate --> QualityCheck

    Sent --> Archived: Mark as<br/>responded

    Archived --> [*]

    note right of Filtered
        Spam messages logged
        but not processed
    end note

    note right of AutoRespond
        FAQ, Support, Sales
        agents handle simple
        messages automatically
    end note

    note right of HumanReview
        Complex, sensitive, or
        high-value messages
        get human attention
    end note
```

## 5. Message Sentiment & Priority Routing

Shows how sentiment analysis drives prioritization and routing decisions.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["📨 Message Arrives<br/>Analyze Sentiment"] --> B{Sentiment?}

    B -->|😡 Very Negative| C["🚨 P0 - CRITICAL<br/>Escalate immediately"]
    B -->|😕 Negative| D["📌 P1 - HIGH<br/>Escalate + 4hr SLA"]
    B -->|😐 Neutral| E["📋 P2 - MEDIUM<br/>Auto-respond or<br/>24hr SLA"]
    B -->|😊 Positive| F["⭐ P3 - LOW<br/>Low priority,<br/>acknowledge"]

    C --> C1{VIP Customer?}
    C1 -->|Yes| C2["🎯 Assign to<br/>Senior Agent"]
    C1 -->|No| C3["🎯 Assign to<br/>Support Team"]

    D --> D1{Product Broken?}
    D1 -->|Yes| D2["🔧 Assign to<br/>Tech Support"]
    D1 -->|No| D3["💼 Assign to<br/>Account Manager"]

    E --> E1{Complexity < 5?}
    E1 -->|Yes| E2["🤖 Auto-respond<br/>with FAQ"]
    E1 -->|No| E3["👤 Route to<br/>Human"]

    F --> F1["📝 Log as<br/>Positive feedback"]

    C2 & C3 & D2 & D3 & E2 & E3 & F1 --> G["⏱️ Set SLA<br/>Target"]

    G --> H["📊 Track in<br/>Dashboard"]
```

**Routing logic**:
- **Very Negative + VIP** = Immediate human + senior agent
- **Negative + Product Issue** = Tech support escalation
- **Negative + Other** = Account manager
- **Neutral + Simple** = FAQ auto-response
- **Neutral + Complex** = Human support
- **Positive** = Logged for morale/metrics

## 6. Auto-Moderation Decision Tree

Shows how messages are filtered and moderated automatically.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["🔍 Content Analysis"] --> B{Spam Keywords?}

    B -->|Yes| B1["🚫 REMOVE<br/>buy now, get rich,<br/>viagra, etc"]
    B -->|No| C{Phishing?}

    C -->|Yes| C1["⚠️ FLAG<br/>Suspicious links<br/>& requests"]
    C -->|No| D{Excessive Links?}

    D -->|>3 links| D1["⚠️ MARK SPAM<br/>Likely promotional"]
    D -->|≤3 links| E{Known Spam Account?}

    E -->|Yes| E1["🚫 AUTO-BLOCK<br/>From blocklist"]
    E -->|No| F{Hateful Content?}

    F -->|Yes| F1["⚠️ FLAG FOR<br/>HUMAN REVIEW<br/>Potential violation"]
    F -->|No| G{Duplicate?}

    G -->|Yes| G1["📋 DEDUPLICATE<br/>Keep first, remove copies"]
    G -->|No| H["✅ LEGITIMATE<br/>Proceed to triage"]

    B1 --> I["📊 Log Action<br/>Update spam score"]
    C1 --> I
    D1 --> I
    E1 --> I
    F1 --> I
    G1 --> I

    I --> J["📈 Update<br/>Moderation Stats"]

    H --> K["➡️ Send to Triage<br/>Phase 2"]
```

**Filtering rules** (applied sequentially):
1. **Spam keywords** - Common promotional phrases
2. **Phishing patterns** - Suspicious requests for credentials
3. **Link ratio** - More than 3 links = likely spam
4. **Blocklist** - Known spam accounts
5. **Hateful content** - Policy violations
6. **Duplicates** - Same message from same/different users

## 8. Daily Processing Timeline

Hourly breakdown of community management workflow throughout the day.

```mermaid
gantt
    title Daily Community Management Processing Timeline
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm

    section Morning Batch
    Collect messages (8-9am)     :active, collect1, 2025-11-17 08:00, 60m
    Filter & triage              :active, triage1, 2025-11-17 09:00, 15m
    Auto-respond (70%)           :active, auto1, 2025-11-17 09:15, 15m
    Human escalations review      :crit, human1, 2025-11-17 09:15, 45m

    section Afternoon Batch
    Collect messages (12-1pm)    :active, collect2, 2025-11-17 12:00, 60m
    Filter & triage              :active, triage2, 2025-11-17 13:00, 15m
    Auto-respond (70%)           :active, auto2, 2025-11-17 13:15, 15m
    Human escalations review      :crit, human2, 2025-11-17 13:15, 45m

    section Evening Batch
    Collect messages (4-5pm)     :active, collect3, 2025-11-17 16:00, 60m
    Filter & triage              :active, triage3, 2025-11-17 17:00, 15m
    Auto-respond (70%)           :active, auto3, 2025-11-17 17:15, 15m
    Human escalations review      :crit, human3, 2025-11-17 17:15, 45m

    section Overnight
    Overnight monitoring          :active, overnight, 2025-11-17 18:00, 660m
    Auto-escalation only         :active, over2, 2025-11-17 18:00, 660m
```

**Daily rhythm**:
- **08:00-09:45** - Morning batch (3 parallel batches possible)
- **09:45-12:00** - Human escalation review + monitoring continues
- **12:00-13:45** - Afternoon batch
- **13:45-16:00** - Human escalation review + monitoring continues
- **16:00-17:45** - Evening batch
- **17:45-18:00** - Final human review
- **18:00-08:00** - Overnight automated monitoring (escalations only)

**Total human time**: ~2 hours/day (3 × 45 min reviews = 2.25 hours)
**Total automated**: ~1 hour/day (3 × 15 min = 45 min, but parallel processing reduces actual time)

## 10. Escalation & Human-in-Loop Flow

Shows the complete escalation process and human involvement.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["Message Flagged<br/>for Escalation"] --> B["📋 Create Ticket<br/>in Support System"]

    B --> C["📝 Generate Summary<br/>Customer info<br/>Issue context<br/>Suggested response"]

    C --> D["🎯 Assign Priority<br/>P0: 1hr SLA<br/>P1: 4hr SLA<br/>P2: 24hr SLA"]

    D --> E["🔔 Notify Human<br/>via Slack"]

    E --> F["🔗 Rich Slack Message<br/>Customer info<br/>Full context<br/>Suggested response<br/>[Take Ownership]"]

    F --> G{Human<br/>Response?}

    G -->|Uses<br/>Suggestion| G1["✏️ Review & Edit<br/>Suggested response"]
    G -->|New<br/>Response| G2["✍️ Write Custom<br/>Response"]

    G1 --> H["🪝 Quality Check<br/>Grammar, tone, links<br/>No sensitive data"]
    G2 --> H

    H --> H1{QA<br/>Pass?}

    H1 -->|Yes| I["📤 Send Response<br/>to customer"]
    H1 -->|No| J["❌ Reject<br/>Ask human to revise"]

    J --> G2

    I --> K["✅ Mark Resolved<br/>Update ticket status"]

    K --> L["📊 Log Metrics<br/>Response time<br/>Resolution quality<br/>Human effort"]

    G -->|No<br/>Response| M["⏰ SLA Timer<br/>Escalates to<br/>Manager"]

    M --> N["👨‍💼 Manager Review<br/>Check SLA status<br/>Reallocate if needed"]
```

**Escalation workflow**:
1. **Automatic ticket creation** in support system (Zendesk, Linear, etc.)
2. **Human notification** via Slack with rich context
3. **Response options**:
   - Use AI-suggested response (edit)
   - Write custom response
   - Delegate to specialist
4. **Quality check** before sending
5. **Metrics tracking** for improvement

## Summary: Key Architectural Patterns

| Pattern | Purpose | Benefit |
|---------|---------|---------|
| **Batch Processing** | Group messages into waves (500 → 25 waves of 20) | Efficient parallel processing, predictable timing |
| **Conditional Branching** | Auto-respond if simple, escalate if complex | Optimal resource allocation |
| **Human-in-Loop** | Humans review 30% of messages | Quality + context-awareness for edge cases |
| **Multi-stage Filtering** | Spam → Sentiment → Complexity → Routing | Catch problems early, reduce noise |
| **Parallel Agents** | 3 monitors, 2 triagers, 3 responders | Maximum throughput with minimal latency |
| **Hook-based Integration** | Spam filter, sentiment check, quality check | Extensible, testable, maintainable |

All diagrams reference the [Overview](overview.qmd) and [Examples](examples.qmd) documents.
